svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 09 · San Francisco · 11/12 Ocean Beach (Common)
svg.desc: Ride the streetcar to the end of the line and there is the whole Pacific, cold and loud. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
